description: A State Bank of India account statement (SBI layout: Txn Date · Value Date · Description · Ref No./Cheque No. · Debit · Credit · Balance).
instructions: SBI statements print two dates per line — Txn Date and Value Date; use Txn Date. The Ref No./Cheque No. column is part of the narration; keep it verbatim. Balances are printed with a trailing CR/DR marker: CR is positive.
